segments.text: policeman. The policeman helped us find the station.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: Police officer is a common modern term that can refer to a person of any gender.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: policewoman. A policewoman was directing traffic.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: You can also say police officer. The term does not specify gender.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: taxi driver. The taxi driver helped with my bags.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: air hostess. The old story describes her job as an air hostess.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: Flight attendant is the usual modern term in American English.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: The flight attendant helped me find my seat.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: postman. The postman brought a letter this morning.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: Mail carrier is common in American English and can refer to a person of any gender.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.  Pronounce the target occupation clearly and completely.

segments.text: nurse. The nurse checked my temperature.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: Mechanic. For example, the mechanic fixed my car.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.  Pronounce the target occupation clearly and completely.

segments.text: hairdresser. I have an appointment with my hairdresser.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: housewife. She describes herself as a housewife.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: Housewife is still used. Homemaker is a broader alternative. For someone raising children at home, stay-at-home parent may fit.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: milkman. The milkman delivers fresh milk to their door.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
segments.section: vocabulary

segments.text: A milkman delivers milk to people's homes. This service is less common in many American neighborhoods today.
